caption: The image is a black-and-white drawing depicting a wrought iron door set within an arched frame. The door features elaborate symmetrical scrollwork, with multiple spirals and curving lines forming decorative patterns throughout the panels. The top section of the door, within the arch, includes large, flowing scrolls and heart-like curves. The main vertical panel of the door is divided into three sections, each filled with intricate swirling and curling motifs, with a central vertical rod running from top to bottom. The outer frame contains diagonal and zigzag decorative patterns. The door is shown within a textured outline suggesting a wall or stonework surrounding the frame. At the bottom of the drawing, the words “WROUGHT IRON DOOR” are written in uppercase letters. The linework is uniformly dark against a light, possibly yellowed background, and the illustration is composed entirely of pen-and-ink lines without any additional color or shading.
title: Wrought Iron Door
